A '''script''' was used by the [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]] to [[Writing/Legends|write]] their [[H'nemthe (language)/Legends|language]]. The letters in a H'nemthe word were created and strung together by a singly wipsy, contiguous line.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

==Behind the scenes==
The H'nemthe script was mentioned in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
